changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: One run model for agent work: the lease of one piece of work on one subject, fenced by its epoch.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE agent_run ( id uuid NOT NULL, workspace_id bigint NOT NULL, kind varchar(24) NOT NULL, band varchar(16) NOT NULL, concurrency_key varchar(96) NOT NULL, state varchar(8) DEFAULT 'QUEUED' NOT NULL, attempt integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, lease_epoch integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, leased_until timestamp(6) with time zone, available_at timestamp(6) with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, deadline timestamp(6) with time zone, stop_reason varchar(24), created_at timestamp(6) with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, started_at timestamp(6) with time zone, ended_at timestamp(6) with time zone, CONSTRAINT agent_run_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uk_agent_run_workspace UNIQUE (id, workspace_id), CONSTRAINT sfk_agent_run_workspace FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id) REFERENCES workspace(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, CONSTRAINT ck_agent_run_kind CHECK (kind IN ('REVIEW')), CONSTRAINT ck_agent_run_band CHECK (band IN ('INTERACTIVE', 'BATCH', 'BACKGROUND')), CONSTRAINT ck_agent_run_state CHECK (state IN ('QUEUED', 'LEASED', 'ENDED')), CONSTRAINT ck_agent_run_stop_reason CHECK (stop_reason IS NULL OR stop_reason IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED', 'DEADLINE')), CONSTRAINT ck_agent_run_counts CHECK (attempt >= 0 AND lease_epoch >= 0), CONSTRAINT ck_agent_run_subject CHECK (length(concurrency_key) > 0), CONSTRAINT ck_agent_run_leased CHECK ((state = 'LEASED') = (leased_until IS NOT NULL) AND (state <> 'LEASED' OR (lease_epoch >= 1 AND started_at IS NOT NULL))), CONSTRAINT ck_agent_run_ended CHECK ((state = 'ENDED') = (ended_at IS NOT NULL) AND (state = 'ENDED') = (stop_reason IS NOT NULL)) ); CREATE INDEX idx_agent_run_queued ON agent_run (available_at) WHERE state = 'QUEUED'; CREATE INDEX idx_agent_run_leased_until ON agent_run (leased_until) WHERE state = 'LEASED'; CREATE INDEX idx_agent_run_subject ON agent_run (workspace_id, concurrency_key, created_at) WHERE state <> 'ENDED'; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_agent_run_leased_subject ON agent_run (workspace_id, concurrency_key) WHERE state = 'LEASED';

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The database refuses every run transition that AgentRunState refuses, and every change of a run's identity.
changeSet.rollback: DROP TRIGGER agent_run_transition ON agent_run; DROP FUNCTION guard_agent_run();

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Each review job points to its run. A run's epoch is the job's attempt number plus one, and its attempt count holds only the attempts that spent a retry. A job that a worker still held runs on a run whose lease has already expired: the run reaper settles the lost attempt's usage and queues the job again or fails it at its retry limit, as for any lost worker.

rollback.stop: Restore the verified pre-upgrade database backup. The previous release reads the lease from review_job.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A review job and its run agree when each transaction commits: queued with queued, running with leased, ended with ended.
changeSet.rollback: DROP TRIGGER agent_run_review_agrees ON agent_run; DROP TRIGGER review_job_run_agrees ON review_job; DROP FUNCTION enforce_review_job_run();
